zh: 窗口外的策略不变，所以先算出不改动时的基准总利润，再看把哪个长度为 k 的窗口改掉能多赚多少。
窗口内每一天都可以独立选 −1、0、+1，当天利润 −s·rate 的最大值是 |rate|。所以把第 i 天重设后的增益是 |rate[i]| − (−s[i]·rate[i]) = |rate[i]| + s[i]·rate[i]，问题变成求长度 k 的子数组增益和的最大值。
基准 base = Σ −s[i]·rate[i]；增益 g[i] = |rate[i]| + s[i]·rate[i]（都非负）。先求前 k 个 g 的和，再滑动窗口每次加进一个、减出一个并取最大值 best，输出 base + best。数值可达 2·10^14，用 64 位整数。
en: Strategies outside the window stay the same, so first compute the baseline total profit with no change, then see how much more each length-k window can earn when reset.

Inside the window each day can independently pick -1, 0 or +1, and the best value of that day's profit -s * rate is |rate|. So resetting day i gains |rate[i]| - (-s[i] * rate[i]) = |rate[i]| + s[i] * rate[i], and the task becomes the maximum sum of gains over a length-k subarray.

Let base = sum of -s[i] * rate[i] and gain g[i] = |rate[i]| + s[i] * rate[i] (never negative). Sum the first k gains, then slide the window, adding one gain and removing one each step and keeping the maximum best; print base + best. Values reach about 2 * 10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The baseline profit is -sum(strategy*rate). After resetting a day's strategy, the best profit for that day is |rate|, so the single-day gain inside the window is |rate|+strategy*rate; take the window with the maximum gain using a sliding window.

## Correctness

Strategies outside the window are fixed. Inside the window each day can independently take -1, 0, or +1, and the best profit is the absolute value of the rate; therefore comparing the gains of all windows of length k one by one gives the optimum.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) space.
